summary: Panels split by handles you drag or move with the arrow keys; a double click puts a panel back to its starting size.

props.name: children
props.description: The panels, one per child, with a handle between each pair. A child can be another `ResizablePanels` to split the other way.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Side by side, or stacked top to bottom.

props.name: defaultSizes
props.description: Each panel's starting size in percent, in order. Shares out evenly without it.

props.name: minSize
props.description: The smallest a panel can get, in percent.

props.name: grip
props.description: Draws a small knob on each handle, so it reads as something to drag.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Draws the border and corners. `false` for a group inside another, which already has them.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the frame. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
